definition: in or into a state of violent or uncontrollable rage or excitement
hook: Berserk used to be a job description, not a mood.
modernAnchor: We say it when someone loses control, a fan after a goal, a toddler mid tantrum. Going berserk.

origin.originalMeaning: bear shirt, one who fights wearing a bear pelt

journey: Norse warriors called berserkers fought without armor, wrapped only in bear or wolf pelts.
They worked themselves into a trance before battle, howling and biting their shields, feeling no pain.
Sagas described them as unstoppable, immune to blade and fire, more animal than man in the fury.
The rage stayed. The bear shirt disappeared. Berserk kept only the fury, and buried the fur.
